title: Soaping the fiddle bow of prima donna Ada Ward
summary: When Cotton Club singer Ada Ward tried to get the band fired, Otto Hardwick soaped the violinist's bow so her obbligato made no sound and she walked off crying.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: So they took -- we had a fiddle player -- Oh, this one particular thing. This prima donna, Ada Ward was her name, the prima donna of the show, and she was trying to get the band fired because the band they had before, she was going with one of the guys in the band. So we said, "We're going to fix her." So Duke had to hire a fiddle player to lead her tunes, you know.
Was this at the Cotton Club?

It was the Cotton Club. And the manager of the Cotton Club kept telling her, he says, "If I was you, I wouldn't bother the band. You're making yourself being hated. Why don't you leave the band alone? They're doing a good job." And Ada, "They can't play for me. They can't do nothing for me. They're just ruining my songs."

So then that new show come in because of the new band. So her part, she come out, she's got to have a big obbligato in front, you know, just she and the fiddle. So Otto Hardwick says, "We got her now." So, just before show time the guy left the fiddle on the piano, Otto Hardwick got some soap and dampened it and soaped the bow, you know, and soaped the bow up good. So when she came out to sing and she

starts that, (moaning), and the fiddle player's supposed to back her up with some little obbligato, you know. There ain't nothing coming out. And she sings, (moaning), and he's just going like mad and he can't get a thing, and she's looking back to see what's happening and we're just sitting there laughing like mad (laughter), until she got so that she had to walk off the stage crying. So the manager said, "I told you. I told you, you mess with the band, now you see what they're doing." From then on, boy, she was just as sweet as pie. You never saw it. She thought the band was the greatest band in the world.
